programs.title: Grizzy And The Lemmings
programs.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are in a protracted conflict over the possession and ownership of "Yummy" a chocolate-hazelnut spread that looks like Nutella. Many foibles ensue.

programs.title: Smurfs
programs.desc: When the evil wizard Gargamel chases the tiny blue Smurfs out of their village, they tumble from their magical world into New York City.

programs.title: Riko The Series
programs.desc: A story about the daily life of a boy named Riko. Everyday life becomes an adventure for Riko and his friend, Q110, as they discover and learn about the world around them.

programs.title: Quantum Heroes Dinoster
programs.desc: Join 4 extraordinary kids as they travel to an alternate Earth where dinosaurs never went extinct, using hi-tech suits and transforming vehicles to protect the dinos from an inter-dimensional villain intent on taking over the multiverse.

programs.title: Papa Pipi
programs.desc: A family-oriented short animation series about the antics of Papa Zola, the lovable but bumbling school teacher, and his brilliant and adorable young daughter Pipi Zola.

programs.title: BoBoiBoy Galaxy Baraju Movie
programs.desc: BoBoiBoy and his friends who travel in space must maintain peace on Planet Baraju.
